title.zh: 规定在萨马省Guiuan市镇设立职业学校，名称为南萨马国立工艺与贸易学校，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Trade School in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Samar, to be Known as the Southern Samar National School of Arts and Trades, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Trade School in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Samar, to be Known as the Southern Samar National School of Arts and Trades, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Thương mại tại Thị trấn Guiuan, Tỉnh Samar với tên gọi Trường Nghệ thuật và Thương mại Southern Samar Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนการค้าในเทศบาล Guiuan จังหวัด Samar ในชื่อโรงเรียนศิลปะและหัตถกรรม Southern Samar แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Perdagangan di Kotamadya Guiuan, Provinsi Samar dengan nama Sekolah Seni dan Keterampilan Southern Samar Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Perdagangan di Perbandaran Guiuan, Wilayah Samar dengan nama Sekolah Seni dan Pertukangan Southern Samar Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3409_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Public Schools, a trade school in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Samar, to be known as the Southern Samar National School of Arts and Trades.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-two. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
